en-US.name: MakerOps
en-US.summary: Private voice control for the MakerOps home AI stack.
en-US.description: Talk to the MakerOps agent liaison: ask questions, dispatch tasks, check status, and approve or deny pending actions by voice. Not published — for personal/development use only.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask maker ops what's on my task list
Alexa, ask maker ops to check inventory levels

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development-only skill; test via the Developer Console Simulator or an Echo device on the same Amazon account.
